translated_text: My Little Sunday, April 28th, 40th. This morning I received two letters, one from the 23rd and the other from the 24th. I'm so glad everything is going well with you. I'll send you the photos you were sending tomorrow; they're so beautiful. But don't ask me for candles. I also make Ilford Bromide paper. You take care of the developer: Your 10 ri - The doctor gave me new medicine and I can eat a little chicken and ham. Today is for resting, I'm regaining my strength, full of confidence - & I'm writing you 2 short letters to Heddy and Irma. Write every day, my darling Baby - to you, Baba. CORRESPONDENCE 2 PM TO THE ARMY. IT POSTAL FRANCHISE. SENDER: Mrs. E. Zweigenthal, 6 Rue Brancion, Paris 15th. Mr. Robert Zweigenthal, Fer R. 1. Czechoslovakian Vel Rota Pézenas Hérault
